messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I got my first ride and a shortboarder came behind me and did a nutty move and just barely missed my head.

output.original_text: I got my first ride and a shortboarder came behind me and did a nutty move and just barely missed my head.
output.joy: I got my first ride and a shortboarder zipped behind me, performing a wild move that just barely missed my head—it was exhilarating!
output.sadness: I got my first ride, and a shortboarder came behind me and did a crazy move that just barely missed my head. It could have been a disaster.
output.fear: I got my first ride, and suddenly a shortboarder rushed behind me, doing a wild move that just barely missed my head. My heart raced!
output.anger: I got my first ride when a reckless shortboarder came behind me and pulled a ridiculous move, almost hitting my head. How irresponsible!
output.surprise: I got my first ride, and out of nowhere, a shortboarder came flying behind me and did this insane move, barely missing my head—it caught me off guard!
output.disgust: I got my first ride, and a shortboarder came behind me, doing a ridiculous move that almost hit my head. It was just absurd!
